temporal_context_policy: full relation keys, no temporal dependency projection; event content and clause word order are excluded by designed factorization
data_boundary: 36 unordered base event-pairs per train/development/evaluation, disjoint across all three splits. 216 temporal training pairs (204 unique texts), 864 development/evaluation documents each (816 unique texts). Three temporal values, two ID presentation permutations; only subject/subject clause order in temporal training, all four goal pairs in evaluation. Initial lexicon, one-event grammar and base split reused from prior project; not an independent human natural-language corpus.
learning_boundary: Each temporal example contains only text and events/presentation/temporal meaning. Initial lexical semantics align clauses to IDs. Two small phase memories learn six complete contexts per direction. Event IDs, graph schema, comma/period segmentation, keys and vector binding are designed. No token-wise operations or word-order labels supplied to learner. Existing single-event component unchanged; four seeds vary temporal memories and new codec, not the component model.
identity_boundary: IDs are local occurrence identities, initially minted in input mention order; thereafter fixed in the packet. Presentation is separately encoded. Generation can reverse presentation without relabeling edge endpoints. Re-reading text mints new IDs: evaluator compares via explicit alpha-renaming to mention IDs, not global cross-document identity. Identical event frames remain two occurrences; external individual identity of identical surface descriptions is not proved.
temporal_boundary: Explicit before relation or explicit unknown state only. No marker means unknown only through the learned empty-marker correspondence. Unsupported markers abstain via public learned marker inventory. Negated/hypothetical event frames keep their slots: relation is a controlled description-level link, not proof that either event occurred, not temporal logic for conditional scope or non-occurrence intervals.
signal_boundary: One D-complex128 vector: 12 event-frame components, one joint directed-time code and one presentation code, scaled by 1/sqrt(2). Partitioned uses four D/4 segments scaled by sqrt(2), same coefficient budget and expected mean component energy, not exactly equal per-message power or total RAM/speed. Undirected erases source/target distinction and exactly collides on reversed edges. No source text, event list, temporal JSON, presentation hint, per-document candidate subset or subpacket in transfer.
gates: Every standard mode/seed/stage exact rate >= .98; each nine-category stage all exact; all known/unknown temporal groups and both generation orders exact, no accepted wrong outputs. Invalid text/packet cases all abstain. Source signals must recover own full candidates. All codec conditions must respect direction-collision and presentation-separation controls and D payload bytes. D8192 zero-noise exact. Teacher-flip, marker-renaming, no-learning and missing-after tests follow expected correspondence/abstention. Symbolic relation-only reference succeeds; no efficiency/superiority claim. Component fingerprint and single-event regression unchanged. Counts reconstructed from per-request records. Low-dimensional/noisy failures measured and not repaired using fixed evaluation.
limits: Two explicit clauses, two registered temporal markers plus empty marker
No learned boundary or binding discovery
No pronouns, omitted arguments or three-event documents
No P1 observation-mask or S1 chip/synchronization connection
R1 inference and Concept updates remain disabled
